turns.text: Classify this incident report into exactly one label: facilities | computing | security | program. Report: 'The projector in hall B shows no image.' Reply with the label only.

For the desk records, the routing rubric: building systems, furniture, and lighting are facilities; computers, screens, and software are computing; access badges, theft, and disturbances are security; scheduled activities and classes are program. Note the rubric in one line.
Classify this incident report. Report: 'Three ceiling lights are flickering in the reading room.' Reply with the label only.

Classify this incident report. Report: 'Thursday's yoga class has no instructor this week.' Reply with the label only.
